svg.title: Mengirim OTP lewat WhatsApp, Cek Verifikasi, lalu MFA
svg.desc: 1. Kirim apa adanya ke +6282125784683. Jangan ubah kodenya. 2. Kembali ke Scalev, klik Cek Verifikasi. Nomor jadi terverifikasi. 3. Nyalakan MFA: Profil, bagian Security. Ganti Email OTP ke Authenticator App.

text.tspan: By default, MFA method is using Email OTP, and you can switch
to use Authenticator App for better security. MFA is used for:
login, fund withdrawal, and change business owner.

g.text: Emergency access codes for account recovery

text.tspan: Kirim apa adanya ke +6282125784683. Jangan ubah kodenya.
Kembali ke Scalev, klik Cek Verifikasi. Nomor jadi terverifikasi.
Nyalakan MFA: Profil, bagian Security. Ganti Email OTP ke Authenticator App.
